body:
List now shows cards only, with the Cards/Milestones selector and obsolete frontend state removed. Legacy milestone-list links open cards, and the mobile project selector fills its row. Existing card filters and pagination are preserved.

Editor, responsive, request-scope and pagination E2E pass. The updated dev application was checked at 320, 390, 844 and 1440px. Milestone source data and planning support remain unchanged. Evidence: progress/2026-09-25-list-cards.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.
